Chapter 1142: 10 Great Saints (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1142: Chapter 10 Great Saints (Please Subscribe)

Ripple Cloud Void Domain.

Wanchuan Chaos Continent, Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

“The neighboring Void Domains have been quite unsettled lately…” several deputy Pavilion Masters whispered among themselves.

The Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion spread across various Void Domains, but only the Pavilion Master could be directly appointed by the Eye of Myriad Laws.

As for the deputy Pavilion Masters? Most of the daily affairs of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion were managed by them, while the Pavilion Master dealt with uncertain paths of evolution and communication with the Eye of Myriad Laws.

“Indeed, many Venerables have been passing through nearby…”

One of the deputy Pavilion Masters remarked with a sigh.

The Wanchuan Chaos Continent was opened by the Wanchuan Venerable, but usually, aside from the Wanchuan Venerable, it was rare to see another Chaos Venerable in millions or tens of millions of years.

However, recently, Chaos Venerables have been arriving from other surrounding Void Domains.

“It’s said that the Postnatal Universe was opened by an extraordinary being, which is why so many Venerables are attracted to it.”

The deputy Pavilion Masters chatted, armed with extensive intelligence thanks to the backing of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

“If not for the gathering of so many Venerables, I would have liked to take a look myself,” another Venerable spoke, tone slightly curious.

As deputy masters of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion, they were merely beings of the Mastery Realm and dared not approach the vicinity of the Xuanhuang Universe.

The area was swarming with Venerables, and beings of the Mastery Realm were too fragile in comparison.

“It’s not just the Venerables heading there…” at this moment, the Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion spoke.

He had been listening to the deputy Pavilion Masters’ discussions and finally spoke.

“Not just the Venerables?”

“Pavilion Master, what do you mean by that…”

The hearts of the deputy Pavilion Masters trembled.

In contrast to the deputy Pavilion Masters, the Pavilion Master directly received orders from the Eye of Myriad Laws, with access to more intelligence.

“Several Great Saints have already headed there,” the Pavilion Master revealed.

“Great Saints have gone over?”

The deputy Pavilion Masters swallowed hard.

Typically, a Void Domain might host a few Venerables, but a Great Saint? Even hundreds or thousands of Void Domains might not produce a single Great Saint.

“Why don’t you believe?”

The Pavilion Master glanced at the deputy Pavilion Masters, about to speak further.

Suddenly, his expression changed slightly.

He then immediately got up and disappeared from sight.

“What happened to the Pavilion Master?”

The deputy Pavilion Masters looked at each other, unsure of what had happened.

Deep spaces within the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

Space-time rotated slowly, and a stable Space-Time Passage formed.

A young man emerged from it.

Immediately, a huge eye took shape, gazing down at the young man, “Galaxy, you have arrived.”

…

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion stood respectfully at the side, cautiously observing the young man who had stepped out of the Space-Time Passage.

The fact that the Eye of Myriad Laws personally greeted him meant he was at least at the level of a Great Saint.

In other words, was this young man before him a Chaos Great Saint?

And judging by the Eye of Myriad Laws’ attitude, it seemed this young man was no ordinary Chaos Great Saint?

“Thank you.”

Lin Yuan nodded slightly. As he stepped out of the Space-Time Passage, he felt the distance between himself and his Primordial Spirit left in the Star Tear Fragment World expanding significantly.

“Then I won’t see you off.”

The Eye of Myriad Laws glanced at Lin Yuan and then quickly dissipated.

“Master.”

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion immediately stepped forward and respectfully said, “This way is the exit.”

For an esteemed guest personally welcomed by the Eye of Myriad Laws, the Pavilion Master dared not show any negligence. The Eye of Myriad Laws not seeing Lin Yuan out didn’t mean he could disregard him.

“Alright.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

In reality, with his mastery of space-time, he could forcibly break free of this space, but there was no need for that. Since the Eye of Myriad Laws had just brought him over, it was polite to be a bit more courteous.

Very soon.

Lin Yuan reached the exit of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

“This should be the Wanchuan Chaos Continent?” Lin Yuan asked casually.

“Yes.” The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion nodded immediately.

Once Lin Yuan’s figure disappeared beyond the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion.

The Pavilion Master finally let out a heavy sigh of relief.

“Which Great Saint is this? Galaxy? I’ve never heard of him…” the Pavilion Master’s thoughts expanded.

But he didn’t overthink it. The Chaos Void is vast and boundless; within certain Void Domains, Chaos Great Saints are exceptionally rare, but overall, there are still some Chaos Great Saints.

The Pavilion Master of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion wasn’t even a Venerable; it was perfectly normal for him not to recognize this Great Saint.

“Pavilion Master…”

When the Pavilion Master returned, the deputy Pavilion Masters looked over full of curiosity.

The sudden disappearance and now reappearance with a lingering change in expression left the deputy Pavilion Masters quite intrigued.

“Where did I leave off?”

The Pavilion Master glanced at the deputy Pavilion Masters.

“You just mentioned that some Great Saints have also headed this way,” one of the deputy Pavilion Masters promptly replied.

“Indeed.”

The Pavilion Master nodded and didn’t continue the conversation.

He had just personally greeted a Great Saint, but this matter was a secret of the Ten Thousand Paths Pavilion. Even if the Eye of Myriad Laws hadn’t advised him, he wouldn’t dare let it slip outside.

…

“Ripple Cloud Void Domain?”

Lin Yuan took a step forward, leaving the Wanchuan Chaos Continent and arriving in the Chaos Void.

“The Xuanhuang Universe is in that direction.”

Even without specific space-time coordinates, upon reaching the Ripple Cloud Void Domain, Lin Yuan was able to sense the change in the beastskin map, the light it emitted becoming increasingly intense. If Lin Yuan hadn’t suppressed it in time, it would likely have directly resonated with the Xuanhuang Universe.

“At least more than thirty Chaos Venerables are gathered there…”

Lin Yuan observed from afar. With his space-time insight, the aura of the Chaos Venerables couldn’t be concealed from him.

“Hmm? There are also Chaos Great Saints? Is it the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix Chaos Great Saints?”

Lin Yuan continued to perceive, his expression becoming peculiar.

The Ancient Ming Chaos Venerable mentioned the Xuanhuang Universe to him but did not mention these two Great Saints.

This is not surprising, as ordinary Chaos Venerables can at most sense the aura of a Postnatal Universe. Recognizing the presence of Chaos Great Saints or identifying them is not something they might achieve.

“I didn’t expect to have such fate with these two Great Saints?”

Lin Yuan’s gaze was astonished. His hometown universe was destroyed due to the battle between these two Great Saints, and now with the emergence of the Xuanhuang Universe, he encounters these two Great Saints again?

However, at that time, compared to the two Great Saints, Lin Yuan was akin to a firefly beside the bright moon; the aftermath of their battle left him struggling.

And now?

Lin Yuan dared not say how much he surpassed them, but at least he was not weaker than these two Great Saints.

“Perhaps the Xuanhuang Universe is emerging also because of these two Great Saints?”

Lin Yuan speculated in his heart, “Besides Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix, two more Great Saints have arrived.”

His space-time insight had reached the Eighth Realm, a domain belonging to the Great Saint tier, thus he could detect the aura of Great Saints.

…

A moment later.

Lin Yuan entered the Desolate Void and saw the edge of the Xuanhuang Universe.

Through this fragment of the universe, Lin Yuan could vaguely perceive the vastness and inscrutability of the entire Xuanhuang Universe.

“No wonder everyone is waiting outside; it turns out they’re waiting for the outer space-time of the Xuanhuang Universe to collapse on its own…” Lin Yuan thought deeply.

The Xuanhuang Universe had endured too many ages.

Although far surpassing the natural universes nurtured by the Chaos Void in size and scale, it did not possess the indelible or rebirth characteristics.

Without its master’s restoration and with the erosion of time, the space-time of the Xuanhuang Universe was slowly collapsing.

This time, the active emergence of the Xuanhuang Universe, on the surface, was due to the influence of the Shadow Demon and Nine Phoenix Great Saints, but in reality, it was inevitable.

Once the space-time collapses to a certain extent, it will reveal itself even without external forces.

Of course, the death of a thin camel is still bigger than a horse. Even if the Xuanhuang Universe was gradually collapsing, it could not be broken and entered by a few Great Saints joining forces.

The Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint had tried to force entry together and not only failed but also caused spatial fluctuations to spread, attracting numerous Venerables and Great Saints.

“In at most two years, the outer space-time will completely collapse, and by then, one can enter.”

Lin Yuan observed and concluded.

Trying to force entry before the collapse? It’s as difficult as ascending to heaven and might even trigger the Xuanhuang Universe’s Origin Source backlash.

This is also why the Shadow Demon Great Saint and Nine Phoenix Great Saint immediately stopped after striking once together.

“I shall wait as well.”

Lin Yuan casually hid in a certain layer of space-time, dividing his mind to sense the Xuanhuang Universe’s space-time collapse while focusing the rest of his energy on cultivation and comprehending the Tao.

During the wait, no strong individuals would make a move either. Those who had achieved the Chaos Realm were cautious; they wouldn’t strike without benefit, especially when the door to the Xuanhuang Universe hadn’t opened yet, thus refraining from fighting each other.

Lin Yuan was no different; his time was precious. Every additional moment spent in cultivation improved his power and attack strategies.

…

“Damn.” The Shadow Demon Great Saint blended into the space-time, coldly watching the continuously arriving Chaos Venerables and the two other Chaos Great Saints besides him and the Nine Phoenix Great Saint.

“I discovered this Postnatal Universe first.”

The Shadow Demon Great Saint was extremely unwilling,

If he had known attacking the exposed fragment of the universe would lead to such a great reaction, he wouldn’t have done so.

But now, it was too late to regret.

The matter of the Xuanhuang Universe’s emergence was completely leaked out.

It’s utterly uncontrollable.

The Shadow Demon Great Saint wasn’t worried about the Chaos Venerables rushing to pick up cheap gains.

He was concerned about the Chaos Great Saints of the same level; as time passed, more Chaos Great Saints would come.

…

“Shadow Demon…”

The Nine Phoenix Great Saint focused most of his attention on the Shadow Demon Great Saint.

This time, if able to enter the Xuanhuang Universe, the Nine Phoenix Great Saint’s primary target would be the exploration insights left by the Thirteenth-tier founder of this Postnatal Universe.

Secondly, to make the Shadow Demon Great Saint pay a sufficiently tragic price.

…

As time slowly passed.

Two years went by in the blink of an eye.

During these two years, five more Chaos Great Saints arrived successively.

In reality, it’s rare for even one Chaos Great Saint to appear among thousands of Void Domains.

This time, within just a few years of the Xuanhuang Universe’s emergence, nine Chaos Great Saints gathered, most of whom used special means to come, paying a substantial price.

Rumble.

Two years passed.

An edge of the Xuanhuang Universe had already collapsed to a certain extent.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan also temporarily ceased his cultivation, observing from afar.

As the outer edge of the Xuanhuang Universe completely collapsed.

The aura inside began to flow out, and Lin Yuan’s expression suddenly changed.

For the beastskin map he held once again underwent a change.
